say.description: One short sentence on what you lined up. Never claim anything is done, opened or changed.

question.description: One short question when the request is unclear; then give no steps.

steps.description: At most 12 steps, in order; each with only its skill's fields.

why.description: A few words: why this step.

files.description: f ids: one to open, show or rename; else the files to move, copy, zip or bin.

place.description: A d id: where find_files looks, what open_folder opens, where make_folder makes.

to.description: Where things go: a d id from <places>, or the n id an earlier make_folder step makes.

id.description: make_folder: the new folder's own id (n1, n2 ...), for later steps' "to".

name.description: A new name, never a path; the same extension unless the owner asks; a zip's ends in .zip.

query.description: find_files: the words to look for.

url.description: open_url: a web address starting with https that the owner typed word for word.
